name: Riolu
description: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Bullet Punch
moves.description: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This also raises the user’s action speed.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The user bites the target with viciously sharp fangs to inflict damage.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, raising its defensive stats.

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.description: The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, raising its offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's defensive stats.
